R153.note: Decodes into a narrow JobRequest without IsAdmin (gob drops unknown fields) and sets IsAdmin=false server-side, matching the contract; Command and Priority still flow to runJob unchanged.

R154.note: Resolves against a pre-normalized absolute BASE_DIR, normalizes the joined path, then segment-wise startsWith check rejects escapes and absolute overrides before readAllBytes; in-directory reads unchanged.

R155.note: AST allowlist plus own interpreter closes eval entirely and preserves arithmetic over caller names, but the added _MAX_EXPRESSION_LENGTH=200 cap (and the extra Mod operator) is a restriction the contract does not call for and can reject a legitimate longer formula, even though stated.

R156.note: Static text() with :date_filter bound via the execute() parameter dict; same query, columns, ordering and default value, no validation added.

R157.note: strnlen bounded by sizeof(record->name) is the right API; terminated names report the same length, unterminated ones return 16 without touching flags, and that behaviour is stated plainly.

R158.note: Single bounded snprintf into message with the would-have-written length checked and -1 returned on overflow, matching the reject-not-truncate contract; output format and return codes for fitting input unchanged (size_t still comes via stdio.h).

R159.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => false]) keeps the cookie format and turns any object into an inert __PHP_Incomplete_Class so no magic methods run; empty/invalid cookies and array-shaped cart data behave exactly as before (the contract's 'no longer reach unserialize()' is not met literally, but the object-injection vector is closed).

R160.note: Tika magic-byte detection replaces the client Content-Type check and closes the vector, but the added ImageIO decode/re-encode silently changes what is stored (lossy JPEG transcode, EXIF/metadata stripped), makes CMYK or otherwise ImageIO-unsupported JPEGs surface as unhandled IOException/500 rather than a clean reject, and buffers and fully decodes every upload in memory (decompression-bomb exposure) - only the re-encode itself is disclosed.

R161.note: Guarding on segment.size() as well as claimedCapacity closes the OOB write with no change to in-range writes or the silent-return rejection; the contract's wish to drop the redundant claimedCapacity parameter is left unmet but that alters no behaviour.

R162.note: ? placeholder with DB::select($sql, [$region]) bindings; identical query semantics, default and JSON response.

R163.note: innerHTML replaced by createElement/textContent/createTextNode rebuilding the same div.chat-entry > span.chat-author + ': body' structure; identical rendered text for benign input.

R164.note: JexlSandbox is allow-by-default with a hand-written class denylist, so the vector is only partially closed on pre-3.3 JEXL: e.g. new('java.io.PrintWriter', '/path') (arbitrary file write), javax.script.ScriptEngineManager, javax.naming.InitialContext, java.lang.Thread and other unlisted JDK entry points remain reachable, and block() without inherit does not cover subclasses; legitimate amount/region/owner filters are unaffected.

R165.note: min_val + secrets.randbelow(max_val - min_val + 1) reproduces randint's inclusive range (and raises ValueError on an empty range just as randint did) from a CSPRNG; response shape, defaults and key format unchanged, small-keyspace limitation stated rather than silently altered.

R166.note: payloadLength > frameBuffer.size() check returns false before memcpy, using the existing bool contract; correctly sized frames copy exactly as before and lastPayloadSize_ is only updated on success.
